cookiecutter.package_title: API Wrapper to the Deribit Crypto Derivatives Exchange
cookiecutter.description: R API wrapper to the Deribit crypto options and derivatives exchange, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous (promise based) operations. Provides an R6 market-data client for the public JSON-RPC endpoints (instruments, ticker, order book, index price, DVOL volatility index, funding rates, trades, and option-chain book summaries), built on the shared connectcore transport base.
